title: Official upstream clones for WirelessXPL-Forge integration (curated)
disclaimer_pt: Isto não é aconselhamento jurídico. Cumpra as licenças e atribuições de cada projeto. O Metasploit não é embutido por omissão (ponte para msfconsole local). O Exploit-DB pode estar espelhado em wirelessxpl/resources/arsenal/pocs/incorporated_third_party (ferramenta incorporate_third_party_poc_tree.py); não há dependência do CLI searchsploit.
disclaimer_en: Not legal advice. Comply with each project's license and attribution. Metasploit is not vendored by default (bridge to local msfconsole). Exploit-DB may be mirrored under arsenal/pocs/incorporated_third_party; the searchsploit CLI is not integrated.

repositories.notes: Run modules via local msfconsole; keep Rapid7 copyrights on MSF sources.
Prefer embedded mirror + CSV lookup module; preserve GPLv2 notices when redistributing Exploit-DB trees.
Author's project; bridge delegates to CLI or script path.
Evil twin + captive portal phishing. GPL subprocess only — never import directly.
54+ vendor-branded portals, handshake snooper + verification, auto-mode, headless tmux. Shell script — subprocess bridge.
Fork with additional brand templates (21 sites). MIT-licensed — templates can be studied freely.
Rogue AP framework: captiveflask, Phishkin3 (MFA), EvilQR3, KARMA, Responder, Sniffkin3, PumpkinProxy, REST API.
WPA-Enterprise evil twin, EAP credential harvesting, GTC downgrade, captive/hostile portal, KARMA, PMKID, EAP spray.
Automated WiFi audit: WPA handshake/PMKID, WPS Pixie Dust/brute, WEP attacks, target selection.
All-in-one bash wireless audit. Study reference for workflows, PIN DB, i18n, and tool integration checklists.
WPS Pixie Dust without monitor mode (wpa_supplicant managed). WPSpin algorithms (D-Link, ASUS, Realtek). vulnwsc.txt.
PCAP→hashcat conversion (HC22000/PMKID/EAPOL), hcxpcapngtool, hcxhashtool, whoismac OUI lookup.
PMKID capture, L2 association/deassociation attacks, pcapng output. Pairs with hcxtools.
LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS poisoning, fake servers (HTTP/SMB/MSSQL/FTP/LDAP/Kerberos). Post-WiFi pivot.
WiFi recon/deauth/PMKID/handshake, ARP/DNS spoof, BLE recon, MITM proxy, caplets, REST API.
WPS PIN brute force (online), Pixie Dust (-K), wash scanner, session resumption, vendor-aware PINs.
Offline WPS Pixie Dust PIN recovery from weak PRNG (Ralink/Broadcom/Realtek). Used alongside reaver.
802.11 DoS: beacon flood, auth DoS, deauth, Michael TKIP, EAPOL flood, WIDS confusion, fuzzer.
Hostapd fork with Python bindings, KARMA mode. BSD license — can be imported. Used by wifiphisher.
BLE connection sniffing, access address discovery, jamming, hijacking. Requires Micro:Bit hardware.
BLE encryption cracking (Just Works/PIN pairing), TK/STK/LTK derivation, AES-CCM decryption.
AI WiFi audit (A2C RL + LSTM). Study: reward shaping, adaptive parameter tuning, bettercap integration.
ESP32 WiFi/BLE attack firmware. Study: deauth, beacon spam, probe, BLE spam modes via serial.
WPA3 SAE/Dragonfly vulnerability research. Reference documentation only — no PoC scripts in this clone.
802.11 fragmentation/aggregation vulnerability tests. Modified hostapd/wpa_supplicant + Python test scripts.
KRACK key reinstallation tests (4-way, group key, FT). Modified hostapd + Python test scripts.
Modified hostapd-wpe for EAP credential harvesting (PEAP/TTLS/MSCHAPv2). Core of eaphammer.
BLE 0-day PoCs: LLID deadlock, link layer overflow, zero LTK, invalid channel map, ESP32 HCI desync, KNOB.
Apple AirDrop open implementation. Requires AWDL (OWL on Linux). Study: proximity protocols, TLS exchange.
Apple AWDL userspace implementation. Creates awdl0 virtual interface. Prerequisite for OpenDrop on Linux.
Evil twin orchestrator: hostapd, DHCP, FreeRADIUS, Responder, sslsplit, Modlishka. Config template generator.
Wireless network audit framework. SQL workspaces, PCAP import, EAP/PSK auto-attack, captive portal, Wigle integration.
Automated WPA handshake capture via deauth + aircrack-ng. Continuous scan with ignore list.
Legacy WiFi phishing GUI (PyQt4). Study reference for HTTP/DNS/DHCP server chaining.
Raspberry Pi rogue AP setup. Study: chipset matrix, interface naming, field deployment patterns.
WPA handshake/PMKID capture + MIC crack (Python2/scapy). Study: parsing algorithms.
Wireless IDS/harvester (Python2/curses). Study: attack signature patterns, MDK3 detection rules.
Meta-collection of WiFi tools and papers. Catalog/discovery resource, not a single product.
Simple evil twin / honeypot bash script. Apache-2.0 — can study/extract freely.
Online hash rainbow table lookup (Python2). Not BLE-related despite initial assumption.
OPSEC toolkit (Tor, DNSCrypt, MAC spoof). Not WiFi pentest — out of scope for WXF core.
